name: Doutor Coffee Oizumi-gakuen North Exit
nameJa: ドトールコーヒーショップ 大泉学園北口店
address: 1-30-4 Higashi-Oizumi, Sanko Sangyo Bldg 1F, Nerima-ku, Tokyo
description: A ground-floor Doutor branch seconds from the north exit that two listings agree offers outlet-equipped seating and free Wi-Fi for casual work.

name: Doutor Coffee Seibu Oizumi-gakuen
nameJa: ドトールコーヒーショップ 西武大泉学園駅店
description: A second Doutor essentially at the station side of Oizumi-gakuen that both a charging directory and Tabelog describe as having power outlets and free Wi-Fi.

name: Komeda's Coffee Oizumi-gakuen
nameJa: コメダ珈琲店 大泉学園店
description: A roomy Komeda's Coffee where select seats have outlets and the chain-wide Komeda Free Wi-Fi is available, making it a comfortable spot for longer sit-down work.

name: Ueshima Coffee Emio Shakujii-koen
nameJa: 上島珈琲店 エミオ石神井公園店
description: A one-minute-from-the-west-exit Ueshima Coffee inside the Emio complex that Tabelog reports has ample outlets and Wi-Fi, opening early on weekdays for morning work.

name: Tully's Coffee Shakujii-koen
nameJa: タリーズコーヒー 石神井公園店
description: A Tully's about a two-minute walk from the station that a charging directory and Tabelog agree provides free Tully's Wi-Fi plus multiple outlet-equipped seats.

name: Doutor Coffee Hikarigaoka
nameJa: ドトールコーヒーショップ 光が丘店
description: A Doutor branch in the Hikarigaoka area flagged as having power outlets and in-store Wi-Fi, called out as the most work-capable option near the station.

name: Starbucks Coffee Hikarigaoka IMA
nameJa: スターバックスコーヒー 光が丘IMA店
description: A Starbucks inside the Hikarigaoka IMA mall right by the station with free Wi-Fi, though no source confirms usable power outlets at this branch.

name: Doutor Coffee Nerima West Exit
nameJa: ドトールコーヒーショップ 練馬西口店
description: A Doutor near Nerima station's west exit listed with power outlets and free carrier Wi-Fi, though confirmation comes from a single directory.
